body:
The session added the driver verb actions: one read of every actionable node on the screen, each with the verbs it can take now (from the schema table's instance rows that take an id: click, type, scroll, screenshot) and the refusal cause each would meet.
In dioxus-native-dom it added DioxusDocument::actionable_nodes and the ActionableNode record (id, owner, keyed), and made the crate-private Readings the ONE actionable rule read by both unkeyed_actionable and actionable_nodes: focusable, or one of the unchanged 27 interactive roles, or current listeners holding an event other than mounted.
It retired unkeyed_actionable's reading of the data-dioxus-id mark as its listener leg; the leg now reads the exact current listeners from element_facts. The mark itself stays: the bridge writes it and event dispatch reads it.
The four id-taking arms of Session::execute now decide refusals through one shared check_target (click and type: disabled, then off-screen, then covered; scroll none; screenshot with an id: in view, empty crop, fonts-unavailable), which the actions read also calls.
Counts moved: VERBS 13 to 14, instance verbs 9 to 10, FieldKind 12 to 13, stand files 52 to 53, run stand 244 to 253 passed, dioxus-native-dom actionable unit tests 4 to 8 (crate 100 to 104), escher-driver unit tests 100 to 102.
Measured: ACTIONABLE_AT_BOOT counter 2, flight-booker 7, timer 3, crud 11, cells 678, load 2; the Cells answer is 106,088 bytes.

The actionable-key rule (sr-actionable-keys): any statement that unkeyed_actionable reads the data-dioxus-id listener mark, or that the mark over-includes an element whose listener was removed (conservative), is now stale; its listener leg reads the exact current listeners, and a removed listener is read by neither reader.

Any statement of which readers use the vdom walk's exact listener reading (element_facts): it now also feeds unkeyed_actionable and actionable_nodes through the one Readings rule, beside the snapshot's clickable.

Any statement that unkeyed_actionable is the only reader of the actionable rule, or that the rule has a single caller: actionable_nodes now reads the same rule, with the shared crate-private roles() and no second role mapping.

The driver's disabled refusal for click and type: it is now decided by the shared check_target (disabled, then off-screen, then covered) for all four id-taking arms, and the actions read reports the same cause without acting.
The snapshot model's list of consumers (text form, parts, diff, MCP results, node-key help, screenshot, the UI graph): the actions read now also reads one snapshot per call and its element ids.

Any count of driver verbs, tools or commands (thirteen to fourteen) or of instance verbs (nine to ten), for example where the lint verb is said to run on every carrier; actions is the tenth instance verb, after graph.
Any count of stand files (stand_*.rs 52 to 53) or of the run stand tally (244 passed, 0 failed, 7 ignored to 253, 0, 7); the new stand file enters the stand-repeat leg through the existing glob.
Any count of dioxus-native-dom actionable unit tests (4 to 8) or of the crate's unit tests (100 to 104), and escher-driver unit tests (100 to 102).
Any count of session_common declarers (33 to 34) or fixtures declarers (31 to 32, their stand files 23 to 24).
The statement that stand_actionable_keys keeps unkeyed_actionable empty on every stand task: it still holds, now measured with the exact listener leg.

Any citation of line ranges in the actionable module of dioxus-native-dom or its crate root re-exports: the module gained the Readings rule, actionable_nodes and four unit tests, so earlier line citations there may have moved.
The unpaged-answer residual res-7cc5bi4k, where cited: it is widened to own the unpaged actions answer beside the unpaged graph (target: next).
Coverage of new surfaces: the actionable rule and actionable_nodes are marked a11y-relevant against the actionable-key rule of section 7; the actions verb itself has no UI element.

body_fields.fact: DioxusDocument::actionable_nodes, read-only, lists the UI graph's nodes in snapshot pre-order that the actionable rule holds for or whose graph owner is set, as ActionableNode { id, owner, keyed }, keyed true where the id holds no slash.

The crate-private Readings in dioxus-native-dom is the one actionable rule (focusable, or an interactive role of the 27, or current listeners holding an event other than mounted), read by both unkeyed_actionable and actionable_nodes.
The keyed reading on the actions answer is the actionable-key check's first wire form; the keyed field on the carriers is PROVISIONAL pending the founder's own word (overseer's call, 2026-11-08).

The actions verb answers, for every actionable node, each verb of the table's instance rows taking an id with the cause check_target would refuse it with; it changes nothing (no focus, list, scroll or diff change) and writes ids, owner ids, verb and cause words and booleans only, never a value, typed text, MASKED_VALUE or NodeId.
ACTIONABLE_AT_BOOT is measured as counter 2, flight-booker 7, timer 3, crud 11, cells 678, load 2 actionable nodes, and the four lean tasks hold 3 disabled controls at boot.

A flight booker option reads covered with owner flight-type until its list opens, flight-return-date reads disabled, and crud-person-14 reads off-screen until a scroll (stand_actions, both layout modes).
A fixture's unkeyed button reads keyed false in the actions answer and is the one unkeyed_actionable reports; an inert or hidden element is not listed by actionable_nodes.
A listener removed on a re-render is read by neither reader, and the unit test also asserts that data-dioxus-id outlives the listener, the in-tree witness that the old mark leg would have counted it.
On Cells 461 of 678 cells read off-screen for click, type and screenshot and all 678 take scroll; the unpaged actions answer is 106,088 bytes, asserted above 100,000 and within 1,048,576 bytes.

Chunk 2026-11-08-what-can-i-do-here adds the driver verb actions: one read-only reading of every actionable node on the screen, each with the verbs from the schema table that take an id (click, type, scroll, screenshot) and the refusal cause each would meet now.
escher-driver gains the private module actions (Session::actions, ActionNode, VerbReading), Command::Actions, Outcome::Actions, schema::ACTIONS, FieldKind::ActionNodes (action-nodes) and one shared per-verb target check, check_target, which the four id-taking arms of Session::execute and Session::actions all call.
dioxus-native-dom gains ActionableNode and DioxusDocument::actionable_nodes. The crate-private Readings is now the one actionable rule, and unkeyed_actionable and actionable_nodes both read it.
Retired: unkeyed_actionable no longer reads the data-dioxus-id mark as its listener leg. It reads the exact current listeners (an event other than mounted) instead. The mark stays and event dispatch still reads it.
Counts moved: VERBS 13 to 14, instance verbs 9 to 10, FieldKind 12 to 13, escher-driver private modules 17 to 18 and re-exports 57 to 59, run stand 244 to 253 over 52 to 53 stand files, escher-driver unit tests 100 to 102, dioxus-native-dom unit tests 100 to 104.
Measured: ACTIONABLE_AT_BOOT is 2, 7, 3, 11, 678, 2. The Cells actions answer is 106,088 bytes for 678 nodes. CI is green 17/17. One residual is open: the replay of a kept actions step is owed a test (a CARRY), and v030-06 is verified only once that test passes.
Driver session contract: the command and refusal schema has fourteen verbs, not thirteen. actions is the tenth instance verb, after graph. The eight closed causes are unchanged.

Any count of instance verbs (nine becomes ten), of driver commands or MCP tools (thirteen becomes fourteen), or of FieldKinds (twelve becomes thirteen, adding ActionNodes or action-nodes) in the driver, CLI or MCP contracts.

escher-driver crate shape: seventeen private modules become eighteen (actions), and 57 re-exports at the crate root become 59 (ActionNode, VerbReading). Command and Outcome each gain one variant, Command::Actions and Outcome::Actions.

The per-verb target check of the executor. click and type met action_point alone in their own arms. Now one shared check_target (with a Cleared result) serves the four id-taking verbs, and no arm keeps a check of its own. screenshot with an id now meets in_view, then an empty crop, then can_paint_text false (fonts-unavailable) before it paints. Target became pub(crate), and locate now ends in target_of.

Dioxus DOM bridge, actionable-key check: unkeyed_actionable's listener leg moved from the data-dioxus-id mark to the element's exact current listeners holding an event other than mounted. Any text that says the check reads the mark as its listener leg is stale. Its domain, order, fields and remedy are unchanged.

Dioxus DOM bridge, read-only readers under accessibility: actionable_nodes joins the snapshot, its diff and the UI graph as one more reader that holds no NodeId. ActionableNode is re-exported from the crate root beside UnkeyedActionable.

Established decision on the driver session's boundary. The actions answer crosses every ratified carrier: socket call, command line, MCP and kept check. It carries ids, owner ids, the verb words of the table, closed cause words and booleans (keyed), never a value, typed text or NodeId. This widens the list of what crosses, by the founder's word.

The hand-written json module gains the writer action_node, of the form nodes with id, owner, keyed and verbs (verb, cause). owner and cause are left out when absent. This holds the rule that every answer is written by hand, and widens what it writes.

Recording and kept checks: a kept actions step keeps its answer whole (its nodes, causes kept, an absent cause left out). Its replay through Check::replay is exercised by no test yet. That test is owed as a CARRY.

CLI contract of escher-session: its verbs now include actions, which takes no argument (an argument is refused malformed, exit 1) and answers one line of JSON. The served stand tasks are unchanged at six.
Cold-agent pipe contract: the pipe's verb list joins actions after graph, and the fake's comment now says fourteen tools.

Front page and capability statement: README and the capability statement now count fourteen driver commands an MCP client gets as tools. The capability statement adds two stated limits, Accepted is not acting and An unpaged actions answer.

Stand and test tallies: run stand moves from 244 to 253 passing, over 53 stand files instead of 52. session_common declarers move from 33 to 34. fixtures declarers move from 31 to 32 (its stand files from 23 to 24). stand_act_spans driven calls move from 37 to 38. The two schema and MCP test names now say fourteen.

Unit-test counts: escher-driver moves from 100 to 102 (actions.rs, a seventeenth file in the per-file list), dioxus-native-dom actionable from 4 to 8, the crate from 100 to 104. cli_commands tests per OS move from 16 to 17, mcp_server from 7 to 8, stand_mcp_tools from 7 to 8.
The log checks' needle helpers gain actions_needles beside graph_needles and option_needles. host_log's hosted calls move from 8 to 9 and mcp_log's tool calls from 11 to 12.
The command span: an actions call records the verb field alone (cause when refused), and its MCP tool_call parents one command. The span's eight fields are unchanged.
The stated limit of the unpaged answer: residual res-7cc5bi4k (target next), beside An unpaged graph, is widened to own the unpaged actions answer as well.

body_fields.fact: Session::actions reads one snapshot and one element_ids map per call and records every id it reads. For each listed node and each Level::Instance verb with an ArgKind::Id argument, in table order (today click, type, scroll, screenshot; no verb name written in the code), it builds the call call_naming spells, runs it through validate and then check_target, and reads stale for a node that resolves to no element.

check_target, crate-private in execute.rs, is the one per-verb target check. click and type meet action_point (disabled, then off-screen, then covered), scroll meets none, and an id-taking screenshot meets in_view, then an empty crop, then can_paint_text false (fonts-unavailable). Its only callers are the four id-taking arms of Session::execute and Session::actions.

The actions read changes nothing. After it, has_changes is false, and the snapshot, both focus readings and the diff are unchanged. An open select list stays open. actions.rs makes no pump, tick, dispatch, scroll_into_view, close_select_list or focus_select call.

actions answers whether a call would be accepted, not what it would do (Accepted is not acting). It takes no argument and answers the whole screen at once, unpaged. The Cells answer is 106,088 bytes for 678 nodes, within the 1,048,576-byte answer bound.

DioxusDocument::actionable_nodes, read-only under accessibility, returns ActionableNode records (id, owner, keyed) over the UI graph's nodes in snapshot pre-order. It keeps each node the actionable rule holds for, or whose graph owner is Some, and keyed is true where the id holds no slash. keyed is the first wire form of the actionable-key check, PROVISIONAL until the founder's own word.

The crate-private Readings in dioxus-native-dom is the one actionable rule: Node::is_focussable, or one of the 27 interactive roles, or current listeners (from element_facts, the exact reading of the vdom walk) holding an event other than mounted. unkeyed_actionable and actionable_nodes both read it and share the private fn roles.

The actions answer crossing every ratified carrier of the driver session was a boundary widening on pattern rul-izni57qv. The founder's word ratified it, relayed verbatim by the overseer on 2026-11-08 (inputs I4, relayed again as I6).

body:
The session added the driver verb actions: one read of every actionable node on the screen, each with the verbs it can take now and the refusal each would meet.
The verbs come from the schema's verb table (the instance rows taking an id: click, type, scroll, screenshot), with no closed list. Each pair is decided by the executor's own validate and a new shared per-verb target check, check_target, which all four id-taking arms now call.
The bridge gained actionable_nodes and ActionableNode, with one shared actionable rule. The unkeyed-actionable check's listener leg moved from the data-dioxus-id mark to the exact current listeners; that mark-leg reading is retired, and the mark itself stays.
Counts moved: VERBS 13 to 14, instance verbs 9 to 10, FieldKind 12 to 13 (action-nodes), the stand 244 to 253 passed over 53 files, escher-driver modules 17 to 18 and re-exports 57 to 59.
Measured: ACTIONABLE_AT_BOOT 2, 7, 3, 11, 678, 2. The Cells actions answer is 106,088 bytes for 678 nodes, and 461 cells read off-screen for click, type and screenshot.
The unpaged actions answer is a stated limit beside the unpaged graph, owned by the same residual res-7cc5bi4k, now widened.

The CLI surface's pending unpaged-graph limit (the cli-unpaged-graph group, fact fct-bzczuomv): its residual res-7cc5bi4k now also owns the unpaged actions answer. That answer takes no argument and answers the whole screen at once, 106,088 bytes for the 678 Cells nodes. The text must name the actions answer beside the graph's.

The CLI surface's component patterns (cli-output): a new answer line for actions joins the one-JSON-line-per-command output, written as nodes with id, owner, keyed and verbs (verb, cause), leaving out owner and cause when absent. It carries only ids, verb words, closed cause words and booleans: never a value, typed text or NodeId.

The CLI surface's graph pattern (cli-graph): the graph and actions answers now both carry a result field named nodes, of different field kinds (the graph's nodes and action-nodes). Any text describing the graph answer as the only node listing, or any count of verbs or field kinds on the command line, moves (verbs fourteen, field kinds thirteen).

Any count of driver verbs, tools or command-line commands in design-system moves from thirteen to fourteen, and any count of instance verbs from nine to ten (actions the tenth, after graph). The describe count row reads 14, 14, 12, 3, 8, 4, 15.

Typography loading (screenshot refused fonts-unavailable with nothing painted): the refusal is now decided by the shared check_target, through BaseDocument::can_paint_text, after in_view and an empty-crop check and before painting. The actions read reports it as the screenshot verb's cause without painting. The rule stands, but who decides it moved, and the read now surfaces it.

Motion and clock text (the driver's advance moves the VirtualClock; click, type and press leave it where it was): actions is a read that moves no clock, opens no list and calls no pump, tick, dispatch or scroll-into-view. A clause listing which verbs leave the clock alone may need actions added.

Depth and hit-testing, indirectly: the actions read reports covered for click and type through the unchanged action_point (disabled, then off-screen, then covered). A covered select option reads covered with its select as owner until the list opens. The hit-testing rule itself is unchanged.

Motion's into-view and scroll text, indirectly: the actions read says scroll is accepted on every listed node (all 678 Cells nodes take scroll) and meets no target check. The last CRUD row reads off-screen until a scroll.

The CLI surface's exit-status and stdout statement, indirectly: an actions call with any argument is refused malformed, so exit status 1 on the command line and isError over MCP. The four exit statuses and the JSON-only stdout are unchanged and now cover one more verb.
The subjects comment's cli entries (cli-output, cli-graph, cli-unpaged-graph): if the actions answer gets a group of its own, the subjects list gains it.

body_fields.fact: The driver command line answers actions with one JSON line, {"nodes":[{"id","owner","keyed","verbs":[{"verb","cause"}]}]}. It lists every actionable node in snapshot pre-order: focusable, interactive-role or carrying a current non-mounted listener, or owned by another node. Each node carries the table's id-taking instance verbs and the cause each would be refused with; owner and cause are left out when absent.

The actions answer is unpaged: it takes no argument and answers the whole screen at once. On Cells that is 106,088 bytes for 678 nodes, within the 1,048,576-byte answer bound. It is a stated limit owned by residual res-7cc5bi4k beside the unpaged graph.

The actions answer reports whether each call would be accepted, not what it would do. A node's verbs are decided by the same validate and target check the executor uses, so a listed cause equals what the call returns. A node that resolves to no element reads stale.

body:
The session added the driver verb actions: one read of every actionable node on the screen, each with the verbs of the table's instance rows that take an id and the refusal cause each call would meet now.
escher-driver gains the private module actions (Session::actions, ActionNode, VerbReading), Command::Actions, Outcome::Actions written by to_json as {"nodes":[{"id","owner","keyed","verbs":[{"verb","cause"}]}]}, schema::ACTIONS and FieldKind::ActionNodes; VERBS 13 to 14, instance verbs 9 to 10, FieldKind 12 to 13, private modules 17 to 18, re-exports 57 to 59.
The per-verb target check became one shared crate-private check_target that the four id-taking arms (click, type, scroll, screenshot) of Session::execute and Session::actions call; screenshot with an id now decides fonts-unavailable before painting.
dioxus-native-dom adds the read-only DioxusDocument::actionable_nodes and ActionableNode over one shared actionable rule; unkeyed_actionable's listener leg moved from the data-dioxus-id mark to the exact current listeners (the mark itself stays for event dispatch).
Tests: new stand_actions (34th session_common reader, a fixtures reader); host_log calls 8 to 9 and mcp_log calls 11 to 12 with the new actions_needles helper; stand_act_spans driven calls 37 to 38; run stand 253 passed over 53 stand files; no span, span field, event, log site, env read, subscriber or dependency was added, escher-driver keeping 2 info_span! sites.

The closed verb and tool word sets: VERBS 13 to 14, actions the tenth instance verb after graph; any statement of thirteen verbs, thirteen tools or nine instance verbs (the command span's verb set, the tool_call span's tool set, the instance-verb list at log-coverage line 52) moves to fourteen and ten.

The command span: an actions call through Session::run opens one command span recording verb alone (cause when refused); the eight fields are unchanged, but a list of the verbs that open the span now ends with actions after graph.
The tool_call span: an MCP actions tool call is a tool_call parenting one command child, read by stand_mcp_tools (its tests 7 to 8, the graph and actions tool-call tests sharing one helper body).

The session library's silence statement: the private modules list (command, refusal, schema, execute, describe, image, recording, replay, lint and the rest) gains the eighteenth, actions, which installs no subscriber, reads no env var and prints nothing; a count of seventeen private modules moves to eighteen.

The Outcome writers: Outcome::Actions joins Shot, Linted, Graphed and Part as an answer written by to_json alone, over MCP its JSON line, kept whole in a recorded check, never logged or fielded; Command and Outcome each gain a variant, and the Debug statement over Command and Outcome now covers that variant.

The refusal detection that Session::run runs in front of click and type is now the shared check_target, run before all four id-taking verbs (click, type, scroll, screenshot) and by Session::actions; a statement naming the detection as click and type only is stale.
The session_common reader count: 33 to 34, stand_actions the thirty-fourth; any enumeration of the module's readers gains stand_actions.

body:
The session added the driver verb actions: one read of every actionable node on the screen, with the verbs of the schema's table it can take now and the refusal cause each would meet.
It added Session::actions, ActionNode and VerbReading in escher-driver, Command::Actions and Outcome::Actions, schema::ACTIONS and FieldKind ActionNodes, and a shared per-verb target check check_target that the four id-taking arms and the read both call.
In dioxus-native-dom it added DioxusDocument::actionable_nodes and ActionableNode, and made one shared actionable rule (Readings). The unkeyed_actionable listener leg moved off the data-dioxus-id mark onto the element's exact current listeners; reading the mark as that leg is retired, and the mark itself stays.
VERBS moved from 13 to 14, instance verbs from 9 to 10 and FieldKind from 12 to 13. The answer crosses the socket, the command line, MCP and kept checks, carrying ids, owner ids, keyed booleans, verb words and closed cause words only.
Measured: the Cells actions answer is 106,088 bytes for 678 nodes, within the 1,048,576 bound. A typed sentinel and MASKED_VALUE occur 0 times in the answer, and no NodeId is written.
No port, socket, env var, IPC method, crate or dependency was added. The founder ratified the boundary widening for the new verb on 2026-11-08.

Driver command schema: validate checks calls against a closed table of thirteen verbs, which is now fourteen (actions is the tenth instance verb, after graph). The seven bounded argument kinds are unchanged. Any count of verbs, tools or driver commands moves from thirteen to fourteen, and any count of instance verbs from nine to ten.
The FieldKind count moves from twelve to thirteen with ActionNodes (action-nodes). NODE_FIELDS 14, the eight causes, the fifteen session errors and the four exit statuses are unchanged.

The driver session socket's carried set (the local IPC vector and the socket's input-validation entry) now also carries the actions answer: ids, owner ids, keyed booleans, the table's verb words and closed cause words, never a value, typed text or NodeId.
The MCP stdio vector's carried set and the MCP server entry: results now include the actions answer, with the same content limits. The tools listing is fourteen tools in table order.

The widening rule over ratified carriers: the actions answer crossing every ratified carrier is a boundary widening on pattern rul-izni57qv. The founder ratified it on 2026-11-08 (Новый глагол actions), relayed by the overseer. The keyed field on the carriers is provisional, pending the founder's own word.

The refusal claim that an id naming no element, or an element that cannot take the call, is refused with nothing run: the per-verb target check is now one shared check, check_target. Its callers are the four id-taking arms (click, type, scroll, screenshot) and Session::actions. No arm keeps a check of its own.

Screenshot with an id: the fonts-unavailable cause is now decided by BaseDocument::can_paint_text, read after the in_view and empty-crop checks and before painting. The whole-screen screenshot path and its raster error mapping are unchanged.

Typed refusals (Refusal, eight closed causes, no String field): refusal cause names now also cross inside an accepted answer, as each verb's cause in the actions answer, by Cause::name. The set of causes is unchanged.
The stable element id leaves escher by the driver's answers, and the actions answer now carries ids and owner ids too. Keyed is true where the id holds no slash.
Password and file-input masking: the actions answer carries no control value, so MASKED_VALUE and a typed sentinel occur 0 times in it (measured on fixtures::password_labelled).

Kept checks: a recorded actions step keeps its answer whole (its nodes, with a present cause kept and an absent one left out), per call and holding no value. The two committed Counter checks are byte-identical and replay green.
Dioxus bridge (dioxus-native-dom): the new read-only DioxusDocument::actionable_nodes reads ids, owner and keyed from the UI graph, and has no log site and no input class from outside the process.

The actionable-key check (unkeyed_actionable): its listener leg moved from the data-dioxus-id mark to the exact current listeners (the element_facts reading). Rows that name the check, or route events through the mark, were re-read and found unmoved.
The command span: one command span per call, and for actions it records verb alone, plus cause when refused. An MCP tool_call parents one command. Those span fields are unchanged.

Log-silence witnesses: the host_log and mcp_log checks gained actions_needles beside graph_needles and option_needles, and read 0 id, name and actions needles at trace under both builds. Hosted calls moved from 8 to 9, and MCP tool calls from 11 to 12.
The cold-agent pipe: its tool list joins actions after graph (the fake's comment moved from twelve tools to fourteen). Its argument allowlist and its replay validation are unchanged.
The unpaged-answer limit, residual res-7cc5bi4k (target: next), widened to own the actions answer beside the unpaged graph, on the operator's yes (inputs#I5).
escher-driver structure counts: private modules moved from 17 to 18 (actions) and crate-root re-exports from 57 to 59 (ActionNode, VerbReading). Command and Outcome each gained one variant.

Settle and waits: actions takes no argument and has no wait field. The read adds no pump, tick, dispatch, scroll or focus call and changes nothing on the screen, so no verb has a wait argument or result field.

body_fields.fact: Session::actions reads one snapshot and one element_ids map per call. For each listed node and each id-taking instance verb, it builds a call with fixed in-bound arguments and passes it through validate and then check_target, running nothing. A node resolving to no element reads stale.

check_target is the one per-verb target check for click, type, scroll and screenshot and for the actions read. Click and type meet action_point (disabled, off-screen, covered). Scroll meets none. Screenshot with an id meets in_view, then an empty crop, then can_paint_text (fonts-unavailable), all before painting.
Command::Actions is validated from actions with no argument, and any argument is refused malformed: in process, on the command line over the socket (status 1) and over MCP (isError).

The actionable rule is one crate-private reading, Readings: focusable, an interactive role, or current listeners holding an event other than mounted. Both unkeyed_actionable and the read-only DioxusDocument::actionable_nodes read it, and the latter returns ids, owner and keyed only.

The driver socket carries the actions answer, {nodes:[{id,owner,keyed,verbs:[{verb,cause}]}]}: ids, owner ids, keyed booleans, the table's verb words and closed cause words, never a control value, typed text or NodeId.

MCP results carry the actions answer to the spawning client with the same content limits. The crossing onto every ratified carrier is a boundary widening that the founder ratified on 2026-11-08 (inputs#I4), and the keyed field is provisional.

The actions answer is unpaged, a stated limit owned by residual res-7cc5bi4k. On Cells it measured 106,088 bytes for 678 nodes through the binary, and stand_actions asserts it stays within the 1,048,576-byte answer bound in both modes.

A kept check keeps an actions step's answer whole and holding no value. Replay of a kept actions step is exercised by no test; that test is owed as a carry on Handler coverage, and v030-06 is verified only once it passes.

For actions, the command span records verb alone, plus cause when refused. The host_log and mcp_log checks read 0 actions needles (the CRUD screen's listed author-key ids) at trace under the package and workspace builds.

CI workflows, the publish job, signing, the agent-run contract and the gate surface: no CI step, agent-run verb or verdict shape changed. The new stand file enters the stand-repeat leg through the existing glob.
escher's own log sink (escher_telemetry's target allowlist and redaction): no change to its fields, targets or the binaries that install it.
Data Protection's browser persistence, HTTP cache, clipboard and file dialog, and the TLS facts: untouched.

body:
The session added the driver verb actions: one read of what each actionable node can take now, its verbs drawn from the schema's table (click, type, scroll, screenshot) and the refusal each would meet.
It added DioxusDocument::actionable_nodes and ActionableNode in dioxus-native-dom, one crate-private actionable rule (Readings) shared with unkeyed_actionable, and Session::actions, ActionNode, VerbReading, Command::Actions, Outcome::Actions and FieldKind::ActionNodes in escher-driver.
It moved the four id-taking verbs onto one shared per-verb target check, check_target, which the four executor arms and Session::actions call; a screenshot by id now reads fonts-unavailable through can_paint_text before it paints.
It retired unkeyed_actionable's reading of the data-dioxus-id mark as its listener leg; that leg now reads the exact current listeners. The mark itself stays.
It added the stand_actions target (8 tests, both modes) and actions coverage in the CLI, MCP, log and recording checks. It measured run stand at 253 passed, 0 failed, 7 ignored over 53 files, the Cells actions answer at 106,088 bytes for 678 nodes, and CI green 17/17.
A kept actions step's replay is exercised by no test; that test is owed as a CARRY on Handler coverage.

The verb count moved: VERBS 13 to 14. Every statement of thirteen verbs, tools or driver commands now reads fourteen, including the cold-agent server's thirteen verbs, valid_step's admitted tools, and isolated's exactly-thirteen mcp__escher tools.
Instance verbs 9 to 10: actions is the tenth instance verb, after graph. Any nine-instance-verbs statement or instance-row pin moves.
FieldKind 12 to 13, adding ActionNodes (action-nodes). Any field-kind count moves.
describe's count row moved from 13,14,12,3,8,4,15 to 14,14,12,3,8,4,15.

The run stand tally moved from 244 passed, 0 failed, 7 ignored over 52 files to 253, 0, 7 over 53. The stand_*.rs files went 52 to 53, stand_actions picked up by its stand_ prefix with no script change. This reaches the agent-run Proof's newest reading and the test-data bootstrap's run stand line.

The session_common module gains the actions() builder and the actioned() reader, and act's match lists Outcome::Actions. Its declarers went 33 to 34, stand_actions the thirty-fourth. This reaches the session-checks helper enumeration and its reader count.

The fixtures module's declarers went 31 to 32, and its stand_* readers 23 to 24 (stand_actions reads password_labelled). This reaches the fixtures reader count and the test-data bootstrap's 23 stand_* readers.
The blitz-tests common module gains the table ACTIONABLE_AT_BOOT. This reaches the stand checks' shared-tables enumeration.

The log checks' needle helpers gain actions_needles beside graph_needles and option_needles. host_log and mcp_log read 0 id, name and actions needles at trace under both builds. actions joins the closed verb and tool sets of the command and tool_call span lines, with no span field added. This reaches the stand log format's per-verb enumeration.
host_log's hosted calls went 8 to 9, and mcp_log's tool calls 11 to 12, one actions call each.

escher-driver unit tests went 100 to 102: actions.rs holds 2 and is a seventeenth file in the per-file list. The dioxus-native-dom actionable unit tests went 4 to 8, and the crate 100 to 104. This reaches unit-count statements and the escher-driver and dioxus-native-dom unit-coverage enumerations.
The cli_commands tests per OS went 16 to 17 (#[test] 17 to 18, two of them linux and non-linux alternates). The mcp_server tests went 7 to 8. The stand_mcp_tools tests went 7 to 8.
stand_act_spans' driven calls went 37 to 38 (run.calls), and its instance-row pin 9 to 10. It reads the actions command line recording verb alone.

The actionable-key check (unkeyed_actionable) now reads the element's exact current listeners holding an event other than mounted, not the data-dioxus-id mark. Its domain, order, fields and remedy are unchanged. stand_actionable_keys keeps it empty on every task under the new leg.

The executor's refusals for click, type, scroll and screenshot by id are now decided by one shared check, check_target. click and type meet action_point; scroll meets none; a screenshot by id meets in_view, then an empty crop, then can_paint_text. Any statement that action_point alone decides click and type, or that each arm checks on its own, moves. The nine stand_act_* targets stay green.
The residual res-7cc5bi4k (the unpaged graph) was widened to own the unpaged actions answer too. This reaches any test-plan site of that residual or its stated limit.

Two test names were renamed from thirteen to fourteen: schema_tests' the_fourteen_verbs_are_named_in_order_each_at_its_level and mcp_tests' the_listing_is_the_fourteen_verbs_of_the_table. stand_requirement_sweep's WITNESSES_020 row v020-01 cites the first. Any citation of the old names moves.
The cold-agent pipe's VERBS joins actions after graph. The cold-agent contract test's fake now answers fourteen tools, where it said twelve.

The capability statement in docs/capabilities.md and README now states fourteen driver commands and tools, with the capability-statement pin green. docs/capabilities.md adds two stated limits: accepted is not acting, and an unpaged actions answer.

Session to held instance boundary: the actions verb is driven through a held session on all six served screens in both layout modes, and the read changes nothing (no has_changes, same snapshot, focus and diff, an open list stays open).
Command line and MCP drivers per surface: cli_commands, mcp_server, mcp_log and stand_mcp_tools now drive actions, and an argument is refused malformed on each surface.

stand_mcp_tools' graph tool-call test body became the shared helper a_read_tool_call_answers_its_reader_and_parents_a_command_recording_its_verb_alone. The graph test keeps its name, and the new actions test runs through the same helper.
Recording: recording_tests reads a kept actions step's answer back whole. The two committed Counter checks stay byte-identical and replay green.
escher-driver's private modules went 17 to 18 (actions), and its re-exports 57 to 59 (ActionNode, VerbReading). Command and Outcome each gain one variant.

body_fields.fact: stand_actions holds 8 tests over the six served screens, in both layout modes. It checks the listed actionable nodes, their verbs and counts; every listed cause on the four lean tasks equal to what Session::run returns, with 3 disabled controls; the stated Cells and load-page causes; the flight booker's options reading covered with owner flight-type until the list opens; crud-person-14 reading off-screen until a scroll; the fixtures reading covered, unkeyed and fonts-unavailable; that the read changes nothing and holds no typed text or mask; and that the whole Cells answer stays within the answer bound.

The Cells actions answer measures 106,088 bytes for 678 nodes through the binary. 461 cells read off-screen for click, type and screenshot, and all 678 take scroll. stand_actions asserts the answer exceeds 100,000 bytes and stays within 1,048,576, in both modes.
The blitz-tests common module's ACTIONABLE_AT_BOOT table states the measured actionable node counts at boot: counter 2, flight-booker 7, timer 3, crud 11, cells 678, load 2.
stand_actions puts a fetch in flight with harness.click on load-fetch, which waits on nothing, where a driver click would wait out LOAD_WAIT.

stand_actions types a sentinel into fixtures::password_labelled and reads it 0 times in the actions answer, with MASKED_VALUE also 0 times and no NodeId field written. The answer carries only ids, owner ids, the table's verb words, cause words and booleans.

No test exercises the replay of a kept actions step; Check::replay runs it through Session::run by construction, unmeasured. The replay test is owed as a CARRY on Handler coverage, and v030-06 reads verified only once that test passes.

The dioxus-native-dom actionable unit tests add four: a listener removed on a re-render is read by neither reader (it also asserts that data-dioxus-id outlives the listener, the in-tree witness that the old mark leg would still count it); a select's options and group are listed with the select as owner; a positional id reads unkeyed and an author key keyed; and an inert or hidden element is not listed.
escher-driver's actions.rs holds two unit tests: every call named for a target verb validates, and an id past its bound reads malformed.

schema_tests' field-kind table is keyed per verb (graph.nodes, actions.nodes), because the two verbs' nodes fields differ in kind. The actions help is pinned word for word among the amended rows, which went 11 to 12.
cli_commands' actions_answers_one_line_of_the_actionable_nodes runs actions as a process against a started host and reads one JSON line. An argument to actions is refused with status 1.

Over MCP, mcp_server calls the actions tool, and an argument reads isError. stand_mcp_tools' an_actions_tool_call_answers_the_readers_nodes_and_parents_a_command_recording_its_verb_alone reads tool_call parenting one command that records verb alone.
